Purpose: personal mini-tracker to quickly compare latency/cost/quality tradeoffs while iterating on quantization and batching config.
How to use: add new row per experiment, include links to eval prompts in linked_artifacts. Keep 'QualityMetric' consistent (accuracy/ROUGE/avg_human_score).
Open questions / next steps:
- Run stability sweep for 4-bit quant across longer sequences (8k+).
- Add error-rate column (nan/invalid outputs) for production signal.
- Try mixing batched short requests + kv-cache for chat-heavy flows.
Quick notes: collected using ad-hoc harness on local dev cluster; costs are rough internal units (USD equivalent per 1k tokens). Latency measured p95 from client-side harness; include deployment region when moving to Dedicated.
